bandReport.notes: Items 1-43, contiguous, no gaps, no repeats. Item 1 starts whole at the top of p02-c1; item 43 ends whole at the foot of p14-c2 ('[ P.T.O.'). All seven pages are English. COLUMN CROPS: the automatic split is clean on all seven pages; no question text crosses the gutter. Only stray item-number fragments of the other column ('4.', '5' on p02-c1; '1' on p06-c1 etc.) and footer folios appear at crop edges; ignored. Faint Hindi show-through from the verso on most crops, ignored. FIDELITY: the booklet prints decimals with a raised dot (0·7, 1·5, 0·015); recorded as ordinary decimal points (items 2, 21). Item 42(c) prints 'Vikramankadeva-' / 'charita' across a line wrap; joined as 'Vikramankadevacharita'. Italics (Pancha Tattva in 14, Madhyamika Karika in 41, the work titles in 42) recorded as plain text. Item 40 options print 'C. 2250 BCE' etc. with a capital C, as printed. Item 15 stem ends without punctuation ('This makes the pH of the milk'), as printed. Chemical equations in item 12 written as \(\mathrm{...}\) maths. FIGURE: item 19 depends on a drawing of a clock face as seen in a plane mirror; its options are text times. CLASSIFICATION judgement calls: 14 (Pancha Tattva) under History / Ancient India / Science and Astronomy in Ancient India; 19 (mirror image of a clock) under General Mental Ability / Clocks and Calendars; 34 and 35 (demographic transition, pull factor for migration) under Economy / Demography and Census since the catalog has no human-geography chapter; own subtopic labels used for 4, 21, 25, 33, 43.
